messages:
jamie - sales: EnterpriseBank wants a 2-week private POC on-prem. They asked for a compact preflight checklist, access steps for validation, and a cost estimate for a 2-node trial. Can we confirm minimal OS/image and driver matrix?

li - infra: Minimal stack: Ubuntu 22.04 or RHEL 8.6. Kernel >=5.10. NVIDIA drivers >=470 (515+ recommended for Ampere/Blackwell). CUDA 11.6+ supported; CUDA 12 OK but test runtime. k8s supported: 1.22-1.26 (prefer 1.24). Need nvidia-container-toolkit present.

ada - solutions: Access flow: provide us one ephemeral jump host SSH (CIDR-restricted + 4h window) and a kubeconfig scoped to a read-only service account for our checks. We'll use an install manifest and offline bundle if they are air-gapped.

carlos - security: For compliance: allow customer-managed KMS, HSM option, and logs exported to their SIEM (syslog or S3). For air-gapped installs we provide signed offline bundles and checksum. Need contact to exchange cert fingerprints.

preflight-bot: scan-result: nodes=2 (T4), driver=470.129, cuda=11.4, nvidia-toolkit=missing, kernel=5.4 -> ACTION: upgrade CUDA to 11.6+, install nvidia-container-toolkit.

li - infra: Bot flagged CUDA too old and toolkit missing. Quick fixes: upgrade CUDA and install nvidia-container-toolkit; sample snippet below. Also recommend enabling device-plugin daemonset and setting node taints/labels for runtime pods.

ada - solutions: Pricing: small trial credit available; will follow up with a 30-day quote for 2 A10-equivalent nodes and token throughput estimate. I'll attach the quote to the customer reply.

jamie - sales: Next steps: @ada send trial quote, @li share offline bundle link + short install commands, @carlos get security contact for certs. Customer asked about fallback to hosted API in case of node failure 9— can we document routing options?

li - infra: We support policy-based fallback at the control plane: route to hosted model variant with request redaction and disabled persistent cache. We'll include a one-page failover playbook.

jamie - sales: Thanks, team. I'll coordinate SSH window with EnterpriseBank and reply with the checklist. :thumbsup:
